title: An Empirical Testbed for ELK Proposal Variants on Synthetic Deception

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Head-to-head comparison of ELK techniques on controlled deception directly tests which theoretical approaches have empirical traction. Eliminates confounds present in natural text. Informative for the ELK research program.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning a model to produce deceptive outputs, then implementing four different probing/detection techniques. Four methods to implement and compare is substantial. Small model scale helps but implementation breadth is challenging for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Four techniques to implement, one model to fine-tune, one dataset to create. The breadth of methods (CCS, logistic regression, activation differences, adversarial probes) makes this a broad survey rather than a narrow experiment. Hard to complete in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
